issues.problem: ym-n4-a explain: 重 'じゅう in compounds' misses the common ちょう reading (貴重, 慎重); mechanical use gives きじゅう.
ym-n4-b tip 'could a child say this word?' fails on 動物, 仕事, 食事, which children say but which are on/irregular.
issues.action: Replaced with a kana/verb-stem vs bare-compound test plus the listed block words.

issues.problem: ym-n3-a: rule, contrast, mistake note and tip claim the ending separates 降りる/降る, but the ます form 降ります/降りました is identical for both (雨が降りました ふりました). The mistake note 'its ending is る, not りる' is false for 降りました.
issues.action: Explain, contrast and tip now say the ます form is shared and the sentence (vehicle vs weather) decides; mistake note rewritten.

issues.problem: ym-n3-a explain: 止める given only as とめる; it is also read やめる 'quit'.
ym-n3-a mistake note called 正 しょう a 'less common reading'.
issues.action: Reworded to state the readings directly.

issues.problem: ym-n3-b: 代 compound rule misses 交代 こうたい; 手 rule misses whole-word 上手 じょうず / 下手 へた.
ym-n3-b example 子供の時代の話 is unnatural; the normal word is 子供時代.
issues.action: Changed to 子供{時代}の話.

issues.problem: ym-n3-b tip 'paired with another kanji it is the on' gives はいちゅう for 背中 and ふうじゃ for 風邪.
issues.action: Added the exceptions 風邪 and 背中 to the tip.

issues.problem: ym-n2 rule says the words are built only from native readings, but 大勢 (ぜい) and 見本 (ほん) contain on readings; contradicts its own explain.
issues.action: Rule now says at least one kanji takes a kun reading, so never read on + on.

issues.problem: Step 5 'on words double before k, s, t, h' is over-general (学生 がくせい, not がっせい).
issues.action: Restated: つ/ち-final on readings double before k, s, t, h; く/き-final only before k, with 学生 as counterexample.

issues.problem: Step 3 calls on-only standalone nouns 'a few' (本, 駅, 肉); there are many (気, 茶, 絵 ...).
